name: frontend-spec-plugin
description: Collects missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs before turning a frontend feature request into an implementation-ready specification.

interface.longDescription: A frontend-focused specification pipeline for requests to add, create, continue, or update frontend features. It first asks for missing requirement, prototype, and API inputs, then explicitly creates or resumes an isolated feature specification without scanning the surrounding project or mixing independent requirements.
defaultPrompt: Add a frontend feature. First ask me for any missing PRD, prototype, and API inputs.
Design this frontend feature and collect the required specification inputs from me first.
Turn my requirement, UI prototype, and API contract into an isolated frontend specification without mixing it with existing features.
